headline: Full House Resorts Reports Q3 Earnings Miss
summary: Full House Resorts missed third-quarter earnings expectations by $0.08 per share, although the company's revenue exceeded analyst estimates.
why: Full House Resorts operates gaming and hospitality properties. Revenue performance is a key metric for the leisure and gaming sector, reflecting consumer demand trends.

impacts.name: Full House Resorts
impacts.why: Mixed results often lead to volatility as investors weigh revenue growth against profit margins.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
